page_title: LEV 1-0 WER | Bayer Leverkusen v Werder Bremen 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+5' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

90+4' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
90+3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) for a tough tackle.
87' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) trips an opposition player and Tobias Reichel signals a foul. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick.
86' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) plays a terrific long ball forward to Keke Topp, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
81' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Patrik Schick, but Mio Backhaus displays great awareness to stop him.
80' A cross from a corner kick by Bayer Leverkusen is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
80' Mio Backhaus is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen). Easy save!
79' Here is a change. Yukinari Sugawara is going off and Horst Steffen gives the last tactical orders to Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
78' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
78' The main referee, Tobias Reichel, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card for dissent.
76' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
76' The attendance is 30000.

75' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Mio Backhaus is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Substitution. Aleix Garcia makes way for Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
72' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Ibrahim Maza will be replaced by Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen).

71' Close! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
70' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
68' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
66' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
65' The corner from Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by Janis Blaswich.
64' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
60' A substitution has been made. Marco Grull goes off and Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) comes on.
57' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Lucas Vazquez.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch so that Ernest Poku can be given a rest.
57' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner which is cleared.

56' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Alejandro Grimaldo was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
53' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
49' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
46' Horst Steffen has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) comes on the pitch for Isaac Schmidt.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+5' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+1' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tobias Reichel blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick.
42' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends the corner into the box, but Janis Blaswich intercepts it and averts the threat.
41' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
40' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Lucas Vazquez, but Mio Backhaus displays great awareness to stop him.

37' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.

35' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.

34' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Mio Backhaus has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

33' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Reichel saw the whole situation. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
32' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.

31' Wasted opportunity! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
30' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Janis Blaswich has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes a short corner kick.
26' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
22' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) brings his opponent down. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
21' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
20' Neat link-up play between Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) and Patrik Schick, but Mio Backhaus reads the game well and the move breaks down.
20' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) sends a long ball in, but Janis Blaswich comfortably gathers the ball.

18' A short pass from Patrik Schick puts Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
17' Tobias Reichel interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen). Bayer Leverkusen are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

16' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
15' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a free kick.
15' Horst Steffen is forced to make a change. Amos Pieper is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen).
15' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bayer Leverkusen due to a handball in the build-up play.
14' The Bayer Leverkusen players halt their celebrations as referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
13' It’s a GOAL! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is the first to get on the end of a lofted pass and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
12' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

8' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Mio Backhaus shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
8' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
7' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
5' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
3' A pass into the box finds Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Janis Blaswich denies him.
2' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.

Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
